summary: Master commercial negotiation for sales teams with practical BATNA, concession, and pricing tools. Strengthen margin and close better deals.
lede: Commercial negotiation for sales teams provides a structured way to prepare deal positions, frame value, manage trade-offs, and secure commercial terms that protect margin and account value. You will practise BATNA planning, ZOPA discipline, concession control, value framing, and pricing governance through practical negotiation templates and deal briefs. The course helps you respond to procurement pressure, long approval chains, and AI-assisted buyer research with greater control and less guesswork. You will also work with issue maps, talk-track responses, leadership reporting packs, CRM-based negotiation tracking, and operational AI-assisted account research to document outcomes and support defensible commercial decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who already work with customer pricing, contract terms, renewals, proposals, or enterprise deal reviews and need a more structured way to negotiate.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop, a calculator or spreadsheet tool, and one recent or current deal example if available. Familiarity with your organization’s pricing sheet, approval workflow, CRM notes, or proposal template will help you complete the hands-on exercises more effectively.
